The '''HoloNet Broadcasting Service''' was a media corporation based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It produced the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] program ''[[Wild, Wild Galaxy]]'' after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. One of the company's field producers was [[Morn Meebler]].<ref name="SWG:HSoOM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||HoloNet Show on Overland Migration}}</ref>
